Area.evidence_source: Scandinavian researchers have begun to utilise theories from pragmatics to understand the communicative function of suicidal behaviour (Hjelmeland et al., 2008; Hjelmeland, Knizek, & Nordvik, 2002; Knizek & Hjelmeland, 2007). We draw here on three main pragmatic concepts, which we use to understand how suicidal intent is communicated and interpreted through social interaction.
